description: This file is a C++ source file containing Google Test unit tests and a custom test event listener for output formatting.

classes.name: TersePrinter
classes.description: Custom test event listener for minimal output during Google Test runs.

methods.name: OnTestProgramStart
methods.description: Called before any test activity starts.

methods.name: OnTestProgramEnd
methods.description: Called after all test activities have ended; outputs overall test result.

methods.name: OnTestStart
methods.description: Called before a test starts; outputs test case and test name.

methods.name: OnTestPartResult
methods.description: Called after a test assertion; outputs failure or success message.

methods.name: OnTestEnd
methods.description: Called after a test ends; outputs test case and test name.
